description: This file implements the core functions for the SlapObjAgent object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal, as well as managing object properties such as object name.

classes.name: SLAP_OBJ_AGENT_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing a Slap Object Agent, containing function pointers and properties such as object ID, name, mode, and reference handles.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapOaoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new SlapObjAgent object with provided context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOaoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified SlapObjAgent object, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOaoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all child or dependent objects required by the SlapObjAgent.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOaoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the member fields of the SlapObjAgent object, setting function pointers and properties.
